rule.description: PR 合入前必须移除所有临时测试代码和调试配置。CI 配置文件应只包含正式的、经过验证的配置。
checkpoints: 合入前检查是否包含临时测试代码
评审人应关注不明用途的配置项
作者应在合入前明确回复临时代码的处理计划

antipattern.code:
jobs:
  single-node-test:
    runs-on: ascend-a3
    strategy:
      matrix:
        model: [Qwen3-32B, DeepSeek-R1-0528-W8A8-EPLB]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        run: |
          pip install -e .
          pip install aisbench

      - name: Temporary debug config
        run: |
          echo "debug testing"
          export DEBUG_MODE=1

      - name: Run nightly test
        run: |
          python tests/e2e/nightly/single_node/scripts/test_single_node.py
